parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id, r.compound_name, s.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN compound_records r ON m.molregno = r.molregno JOIN docs d ON r.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_structures s ON m.molregno = s.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123860' ORDER BY m.chembl_id, r.compound_name, s.canonical_smiles
